name: 93536 · Lancaster, CA
findings: ZIP 93536 (Lancaster) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93536 (Lancaster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93536 (Lancaster) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93536 (Lancaster) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
